# Dear ImGui

Version: v1.91.9b, commit `f5befd2d29e66809cd1110a152e375a7f1981f06`.
Source: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui
License: MIT, included in `dear_imgui/LICENSE.txt`.

Only the core files and official Win32 / DirectX 11 backends are vendored.
The library is compiled into the application; no download is needed to build or run it.
